one_liner: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander leads the Oklahoma City Thunder at 45.4 points-plus-rebounds-plus-assists per 36 minutes across 245 team-games.
three_things: SGA's 45.4 combined PRA-per-36 is among the highest top-contributor rates in the sample.
He is also the team's minutes leader at 7,375.7 total minutes.
The team scored 119.0 points per game in the latest season of the sample.
context_note: The 'top contributor' is the player with the most total minutes for the team, which for Oklahoma City coincides with its lead star. PRA-per-36 sums points, rebounds, and assists per 36 minutes and is a raw box rate, not an impact metric. ppg_latest_season is a single-season team average while the rest of the sample spans three seasons; pace_proxy is a proxy, not official possession-based pace. The manifest is descriptive_only with no schedule or opponent adjustment.
